why: The guard exactly as it shipped, and as it stayed through PR #563 -- which put the Main Menu button on every end screen in `hud.ts` and changed no handler. The result was a button that was visible, focusable and did nothing on all three losing endings: a campaign game-over, a failed practice level and a versus draw. That is the stranding issue #323 opened about, moved one layer down, and no test in this file reached it because every quit case drove the handler from `paused` or from `outcome-win`. It is also what Choose Level rides on, so this breaks the practice end screen's other action with it.
killedBy: startGameWith: leaving a CLEARED level for the main menu keeps the run also reaches the Main Menu from a LOST match, which is where it was inert
